summary_1line: Kaikeyi presses her demanded boons while King Dasaratha, collapsed in anguish, laments the thought of exiling his beloved son Rama.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Dasaratha lies collapsed on the floor in despair while Queen Kaikeyi stands coldly before him demanding her promised boons.
The anguished king raises himself slightly, lamenting that he must send the lotus‑eyed Rama to the dark Dandaka forest.
Night falls over the palace as Dasaratha gazes at the moon without joy, stricken with grief over Rama’s fate.
